DigitalBurj AI

AI employees that work inside your operations.

The AI rule: authenticate → authorise → use approved tools → validate → approve high-risk actions → audit.

01Owner / CEO AI Executive Daily briefing on cash, sales, approvals and exceptions. 02Sales team AI Sales Lead summaries, qualification, follow-ups and quote drafts. 03Customers AI Customer Service Website and WhatsApp support with clean escalation. 04Finance AI Finance Assistant Invoice extraction, reconciliation help and collections. 05HR & staff AI HR Assistant Policy answers, leave guidance and onboarding. 06Operations AI Operations Late work, SLA exceptions and workload imbalance. 07All teams AI Document Intelligence Structured data from invoices, POs, contracts and CVs. 08Employees AI Knowledge Base Permission-aware answers from SOPs and manuals.

Industry Solutions

Fifteen sectors. One core.

  • 01 Logistics & Freight Rates, shipments, containers, customs workflow, POD and job costing.
  • 02 Travel & Tourism Travel CRM, bookings, suppliers, refunds and booking profitability.
  • 03 Trading & Distribution Price lists, orders, stock, delivery and receivables in one flow.
  • 04 Real Estate Listings, units, tenants, viewings, leases and commissions.
  • 05 Construction Tenders, budgets, subcontractors, variations and progress billing.
  • 06 Facility Management Contracts, assets, preventive maintenance and SLA work orders.
  • 07 Professional Services Projects, time, contracts, billing and client portal.
  • 08 Recruitment Clients, jobs, candidates, interviews and placements.
  • 09 Retail POS, inventory, promotions, loyalty and delivery.
  • 10 Automotive Service jobs, parts, warranty, sales and rentals.
  • 11 Hospitality Reservations, rooms, housekeeping and restaurant POS.
  • 12 Education Admissions, classes, attendance, fees and portals.
  • 13 Manufacturing BOM, work orders, quality, costing and traceability.
  • 14 Healthcare Administration Appointments, billing, staff and procurement.
  • 15 E-commerce Catalog, checkout, orders and returns — posted to finance.

A technology operating partner for SMEs: one platform combining business software, AI, automation, growth, custom development, industry modules, training and verified talent.

Businesses with roughly 1–250 employees, limited in-house IT, tools spread across spreadsheets and chat apps, and a need for better visibility, automation and growth.

It can, module by module. Or we integrate with what you keep. Industry modules extend the core rather than duplicating CRM, finance or HR.

AI never gets unrestricted database access. It authenticates, uses only approved tools, validates results and sends high-risk actions to a person for approval — with a full audit log.

Simple company-level plans with usage limits on expensive resources like AI, WhatsApp and storage. Migration, custom workflows, integrations, websites and apps are quoted separately.
